description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: A sofa sits centrally facing the living area; a dining table with four chairs sits between the sofa and the bed zone.. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen, straight corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed visible from front door, visible from kitchen. Fully open plan — cooking smells and sounds reach the sleeping area directly. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (single open studio, no separate bedrooms); roommates or flat-sharers needing privacy (open sleeping area visible from entry and kitchen); people needing a home office or desk space (no desk and limited room); anyone requiring separated, private sleeping quarters.
